_note: Nipple and ball variety (S-21): {sex: {group: {morph: [low, high]}}}. Every template of that sex gets Morph@low:high, so each NPC rolls their own, exactly as tools/genital_shapes.json does for women's genital shapes (S-17); one loader reads both files and refuses a morph they both name. A range REPLACES the preset's own value for that morph, as OBody's nipple randomisation does under its key. Group 'nipples' is SetNippleRand, 'genitals' is SetGenitalRand (S-24). Never here: a runtime state (S-16), AnusBack (S-17), or anything that changes the shaft (S-21, owner): its length and width decide where fo4-anatomy's collision sits.
_why: Agent's choice within the owner's poll (2026-09-23: nipples for both sexes, balls for men, never the shaft), measured on the deployed bodies (scratchpad measure_variety.py): per unit of slider, NippleSize moves the mesh at most 0.28 units with a worst local stretch of 1.47x, NippleAreola 0.84 / 1.81x, NippleTip 0.37 / 1.66x, NippleLength 1.13 / 3.57x (so it gets the narrowest range); BTNippleSize 0.21 / 1.08x, BTNippleWidth 1.14 / 1.37x, BTNippleTipSize 0.32 / 1.94x, BTBallSize 0.27 / 1.63x, BTBallAsymmetry 0.49 / 1.48x. Each range spans the values the installed presets themselves use (60 female, 8 male, manifest 531999: NippleSize -0.5..0.6 mean 0.17, NippleAreola mean 0.29, NippleTip mean 0.12, NippleLength mean 0.11; BTBallSize 0.24..1.0) without the extremes. Left to the presets: nipple PLACEMENT (Distance, Down, Up, TwistUp) and breast-point shape (Perkiness, Perk2, Shape: 3.34x stretch), which belong to a preset's design; 'Balls' (1.8 units per unit, the big size control); and NipBGone, which is ORefit's tool.
